newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine forex market to be closed on Nov 22, 25.
newsitem.headline: Philippine forex market to be closed on Nov 22, 25.

text.p: The Philippine foreign exchange market will be closed on Friday, November 22 and Monday, November 25, the Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP) said on Tuesday.
"In view of the APEC meeting, there will be no trading on the 22nd and 25th of November 1996," BAP executive director Leonilo Coronel said in a statement.
He said transactions done on November 21 will be settled on November 26.
Ministers and leaders of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting are meeting in Manila and the nearby Subic free port starting November 22.
Earlier, President Fidel Ramos declared November 22 to 26 a special holiday in both Manila and Subic to ease traffic congestion in the areas.
But Ramos had exempted banks and other utility companies from the holiday saying that they are critical to the economy.
Banks will therefore remain open for clearing and money market operations will continue, a Central Bank official said.

An official at the Philippine Stock Exchange said the bourse had not yet decided on suspension of trading during the APEC meetings. A decision is expected on Wednesday morning, he said. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
